capabilities: Insert a [!progress] callout above a checklist to show a live progress bar
Count checked and unchecked items, including nested items
Colour the bar with one of 15 two-letter colour codes
Choose between fraction, open/done, or both counter styles in settings
Update bars live on every keystroke while preserving cursor and undo history
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and that non-open notes update their bars only when next edited.
problem: Obsidian shows no at-a-glance completion status for long checklists, so you must count checked and unchecked items yourself.
summary: Renders a live progress bar above checklist blocks in notes, driven by a [!progress] callout that counts checked items.
